title: Token Velocity Beacon: multi-model microbenchmark with p95 regression alarms
creator: Aisha Khan
description:
Purpose: build and operationalize a lightweight, extensible tokens-per-second microbenchmark called the Token Velocity Beacon. This harness will produce reproducible steady-state and microburst token throughput numbers across our core model catalog, track p95 latency for generation endpoints, and detect regressions via automated differential comparisons against rolling baselines.

Goals:
- Provide a fast, CI-friendly job that runs nightly and on PRs for model-serving changes.
- Measure tokens/sec across representative sequences and batch sizes, both with and without KV cache priming.
- Track p95 generation latency and expose regression detection rules (absolute and relative thresholds).
- Emit results to our telemetry backend and surface historical trends in a dashboard; send actionable alerts to #infra-perf if a regression is detected.

Scope and constraints:
- Core models only (initially: redwood-base-1.0, rw-chat-small, rw-chat-medium).
- Runner must be containerized and runnable inside our CI (self-hosted runner) and on dedicated infra for nightly runs.
- Keep test runtime below 12 minutes for PR gating; nightly full sweep can be longer (up to 45m).
- Avoid production traffic or customer data; use synthetic prompts and deterministic RNG seeds where applicable.

What this is not: a full-scale chaos or load test for autoscaling. Beacon is a microbenchmark focused on tokens/sec and p95 sensitivity to code/kernel changes.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible harness (container image + runner script) that reports tokens/sec and p95 for each model/variant
Nightly job writes per-run metrics to telemetry (prometheus-compatible metrics + JSON artifact) and retains results for 90 days
PR gating job runs subset of tests (3 representative sequences) and fails the check if p95 regresses > 12% or tokens/sec drops > 10% compared to 7-day rolling baseline
Regression detector posts a summary and linked artifact to #infra-perf and creates ENG tickets for regressions that cross high-impact thresholds
Dashboard displays 7/30/90-day trendlines and allows pivots by model, sequence-length, batch-size, and KV cache state
tasks: Design benchmark permutations: sequence lengths [32,128,512], batch sizes [1,4,8], KV cache on/off
Implement runner: Go binary that drives the runtime via API, measures tokens emitted and latencies, and outputs canonical JSON
Create Docker image and CI job definitions (circleci/workflow or github-actions matrix) for PR/nightly runs
Hook metrics exporter to push histograms/gauges to telemetry and store raw JSON artifacts in S3
Write regression detection logic: rolling baseline, statistical smoothing, and alert thresholds
Build Grafana dashboard and reusable panels for the console team to embed
Add canary step for dedicated capacity variants and quantized model variants
Document runbook and add automated ticketing for severe regressions
